demonstration_sequence.headline: 1. Initialize Orbital Simulation
demonstration_sequence.description: Earth and both space objects positioned in ECI frame. Protected satellite in 7000 km circular orbit; debris object 10 km ahead.

demonstration_sequence.headline: 2. Nominal Trajectory Propagation
demonstration_sequence.description: Satellite and debris propagate forward along two-body Keplerian orbits. Authoritative state solved via numerical RK4 in Python.

demonstration_sequence.headline: 3. Conjunction Screening Trigger
demonstration_sequence.description: Conjunction screening filter breached (< 25 km threshold). Predicted closest encounter at TCA = 769.6 s.

demonstration_sequence.headline: 4. Encounter Assessment & Risk Metrics
demonstration_sequence.description: Nominal miss distance evaluated: 1563.5 m (< 2000.0 m safety limit). Critical risk detected.

demonstration_sequence.headline: 5. Autonomous Avoidance Planning
demonstration_sequence.description: Planner evaluates candidate catalog and selects optimal impulse: MAN_006_-R_3.00mps_T170s.

demonstration_sequence.headline: 6. Impulsive Burn Execution
demonstration_sequence.description: Instantaneous delta-v applied in RTN frame (-R, 3.00 m/s). Velocity updated in ECI; position remains continuous.

demonstration_sequence.headline: 7. Modified Trajectory & Covariance Drift
demonstration_sequence.description: Satellite drifts onto modified orbit. Trajectory deviation accumulates safely away from the debris approach path.

demonstration_sequence.headline: 8. Post-Manoeuvre Verification & Safety Margin
demonstration_sequence.description: Encounter successfully resolved. Miss distance increased to 2454.4 m (+890.9 m increase). Collision risk mitigated.
